characters.name: Bartender
characters.description: a massive moss-green troll bartender with a prominent underbite, cracked tusks, a braided beard full of beer caps, a black leather vest and studded wristbands, chunky troll body, leather and studs

scenes.name: monk_enters_tavern
scenes.prompt: Inside the smoky troll tavern, the skinny bald human monk with pale human skin and a brown hooded robe stands in the open wooden doorway on the left, looking around in awe, long tables, barrels and skull-shaped mugs, warm amber firelight.
scenes.motion_prompt: The monk walks from the doorway toward the bar, looking left and right in amazement as smoke drifts through the firelight.
scenes.end_prompt: The monk has reached the bar in the center of the tavern and rests both hands on the wooden counter, looking up with wide curious eyes.

scenes.name: bartender_pours_beer
scenes.prompt: Inside the troll tavern, the small skinny bald human monk with pale human skin stands at the bar holding a small empty wooden mug while the massive moss-green troll bartender behind the counter grabs a huge barrel of glowing emerald beer, shelves of skull-shaped mugs behind them.
scenes.motion_prompt: The bartender lifts and tilts the huge barrel and glowing emerald beer pours and foams into the monk's mug while the monk watches with wide innocent eyes.
scenes.end_prompt: The monk's wooden mug is full to the brim with foaming glowing emerald beer, the bartender holds the tilted barrel above it and grins with his underbite.

scenes.name: monk_first_sip
scenes.prompt: Close shot at the bar of the troll tavern, the small skinny bald human monk with pale human skin holds a wooden mug full of glowing emerald beer with both hands while the massive moss-green troll bartender leans on the counter watching him, warm amber firelight.
scenes.motion_prompt: The monk raises the mug and takes a long sip, then lowers it with a foam moustache while the bartender laughs and slaps the counter.
scenes.end_prompt: The monk lowers the mug with a white foam moustache and a surprised happy face, while the bartender laughs loudly with one hand slapping the counter.
